description: Source code for a JSON writer utility, implementing functions to build JSON objects and arrays with optional pretty-printing, including handling of string quoting, indentation, and nested structures.

methods.name: append_quoted_string
methods.description: Appends a JSON-quoted version of the input string to the output buffer, handling escape characters and control characters.

methods.name: indent_pretty
methods.description: Adds indentation spaces based on the current open stack length for pretty-printing.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object or array, updating the open stack and formatting state.

methods.name: assert_in_object
methods.description: Checks that the current open stack top is an object, triggers BUG if not.

methods.name: assert_in_array
methods.description: Checks that the current open stack top is an array, triggers BUG if not.

methods.name: maybe_add_comma
methods.description: Adds a comma if a previous element has been added at the current level.

methods.name: fmt_double
methods.description: Formats a double value with specified precision into the JSON output.

methods.name: object_common
methods.description: Handles common steps for adding a key-value pair in a JSON object, including quoting the key and adding colon.

methods.name: array_common
methods.description: Handles common steps for adding an element in a JSON array, including comma management.

methods.name: assert_is_terminated
methods.description: Ensures that the current JSON structure is properly closed with a closing bracket.

methods.name: jw_object_begin
methods.description: Starts a new JSON object with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: jw_object_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to a JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_intmax
methods.description: Adds an integer value with maximum size to a JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_double
methods.description: Adds a double value with specified precision to a JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true value to a JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false value to a JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean value to a JSON object based on an integer.

methods.name: jw_object_null
methods.description: Adds a null value to a JSON object.

methods.name: increase_indent
methods.description: Increases indentation of a string buffer for pretty-printing nested JSON.

methods.name: kill_indent
methods.description: Removes indentation from a string buffer to convert pretty JSON to compact form.

methods.name: append_sub_jw
methods.description: Appends a nested JSON writer's output to the current JSON, adjusting indentation based on context.

methods.name: jw_object_sub_jw
methods.description: Adds a nested JSON object as a value for a key.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON object for a key.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON array for a key.

methods.name: jw_array_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON array with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: jw_array_string
methods.description: Adds a string element to a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_intmax
methods.description: Adds a maximum size integer element to a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_double
methods.description: Adds a double element to a JSON array with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_array_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true element to a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false element to a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean element to a JSON array based on an integer.

methods.name: jw_array_null
methods.description: Adds a null element to a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_sub_jw
methods.description: Adds a nested JSON writer as an element in a JSON array.

methods.name: jw_array_argc_argv
methods.description: Adds multiple string elements to a JSON array from argc and argv.

methods.name: jw_array_argv
methods.description: Adds multiple string elements to a JSON array from a null-terminated list.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON object within an array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts an inline JSON array within an array.

methods.name: jw_is_terminated
methods.description: Checks if the current JSON structure is properly closed.

methods.name: jw_end
methods.description: Closes the current JSON object or array, updating the open stack.
